children: DDC Solutions' modular rack containment gives Duos Edge AI a fast, flexible way to cool any GPU platform as it scales its Columbus, Georgia edge data center.

SAN DIEGO, Sept. 1, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- DDC Solutions, part of the Daikin Applied group, today announced that Duos Edge AI, Inc., a subsidiary of Duos Technologies Group, Inc. (Nasdaq: DUOT), has selected DDC's rack containment units to cool and protect high-density GPU infrastructure at Duos Edge AI's Columbus, Georgia data center campus.

The agreement reflects a broader shift in where high-density AI infrastructure is being deployed. As GPU workloads move beyond hyperscale campuses into distributed, edge-based sites, operators are increasingly running dense compute in facilities that weren't originally designed around that density — putting new pressure on thermal management in particular, since edge sites typically have less built-in cooling infrastructure and less room to add it than a traditional data center. Rack-level containment addresses that gap directly, managing heat and protecting hardware at the source without requiring the facility itself to be rebuilt around it.

DDC's S-Series rack containment units provide sealed physical containment at the rack level, using facility-supplied chilled water and power to manage airside thermal load for GPU racks. The units' NEMA 3R-rated enclosure protects hardware from contamination and unauthorized access, while integrated rack-level fire suppression detects and contains thermal events before they can propagate to adjacent equipment. The modular design scales up or down with a site's footprint and adapts to a range of GPU platforms and densities, without requiring a custom build for each deployment — a fit for the compact, fast-turn environments Duos Edge AI operates in.

"Edge environments like Columbus need cooling that can go in fast and adapt just as fast as the hardware does. That's one use case DDC is built for — a modular containment system that drops into a site and flexes across GPU platforms, so Duos Edge AI isn't locked into one configuration as deployments evolve and customer requirements change."
Keith Markley, Chief Executive Officer, DDC Solutions
Cooling built to keep pace with rapid deployment

Duos Edge AI has built its platform around bringing high-density compute capacity online quickly for its customers, with a track record of standing up edge data centers in as little as 90 days. DDC's rack containment units are built to rapidly bring integrated cooling and asset protection to any new AI infrastructure project, without slowing down deployment.

"As we bring additional AI infrastructure capacity online at our Columbus campus, protecting that hardware matters as much as the power and space itself. DDC's rack containment gives us that protection without slowing down how fast we can get capacity into production for our customers."
Doug Recker, Chief Executive Officer, Duos Technologies Group, Inc.

DDC Solutions, part of the Daikin Applied group, develops next-generation rack containment and cooling platforms for high-density AI and HPC environments. DDC's solutions are engineered to protect critical GPU assets, support any density cooling strategy, reduce mechanical complexity, and enable more efficient, risk-resilient data center operations.
